queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.sender_id, sender.username AS sender_name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.content, '$.content')) AS message_content, m.created_at, m.message_type, sc.chat_type, sc.id AS shared_chat_id, g.id AS group_id, g.group_name, CASE WHEN LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.content, '$.content'))) = LOWER(:exactKeyword) THEN 2 WHEN LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.content, '$.content'))) LIKE LOWER(:keyword) ESCAPE '!' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS match_quality, (CASE WHEN LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.content, '$.content'))) LIKE :term0 ESCAPE '!' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.content, '$.content'))) LIKE :term1 ESCAPE '!' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched_terms  FROM message m JOIN shared_chat sc ON sc.id = m.chat_id LEFT JOIN `user` sender ON sender.id = m.sender_id LEFT JOIN `group` g ON g.shared_chat_id = sc.id AND sc.chat_type = 'GROUP' AND g.status = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.group_id = g.id AND gm.user_id = :actor AND gm.join_status = 'ACCEPTED' AND gm.kicked_at IS NULL)  WHERE COALESCE(m.is_recalled, 0) = 0 AND ((sc.chat_type = 'PRIVATE' AND (sc.participant_1_id = :actor OR sc.participant_2_id = :actor)) OR (sc.chat_type = 'GROUP' AND g.id IS NOT NULL))  AND (LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.content, '$.content'))) LIKE :term0 ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.content, '$.content'))) LIKE :term1 ESCAPE '!')  ORDER BY match_quality DESC, matched_terms DESC, m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT :size OFFSET :offset
